scope: Independent checkpoint, not final candidate acceptance. Production is mutable. Fail refers to directly inspected source-bound baseline or candidate evidence; later unreviewed production changes do not inherit a positive or negative current-source certification. Pass is only the bounded exact evidence stated; Unmeasured means missing independent complete-clause evidence.

clauses.name: Continuous believable forms
clauses.criterion: At normal chase distance and a two-metre close view, the head, neck, shoulders, elbows, hands, hips, knees and ankles have anatomically credible silhouettes. No visible cuboid limbs, primitive joint balls, separated sleeves, open seams, inverted surfaces or visibly faceted face. Hidden simple collision is appropriate.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Actual fitted inspector independently211/0 and all9 originals viewed; complete Main six-still review159/0 plus50 preservation checks verifies visible neck/waist/feet continuity at shown states. Splayed hands, stiff collar and angular deepest grabbed thigh/knee remain observed finish gaps. Earlier procedural D001 is historical; no current full-action/anatomy/AAA pass.
clauses.next_action: Review final worst bends and normal-speed transitions, then owner art acceptance.

clauses.name: Adult scale and proportions
clauses.criterion: One consistent adult rider scale, measured against the approximately metre-based world. Document height, board dimensions and limb proportions. Neck/shoulder/hip widths and face placement must hold in front, side, rear and three-quarter views.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Main packet records actual native envelope/head/board bounds and0.30/0.29m arm,0.43/0.41m leg segments; source declares authentic adult morphs. Independent close/chase images look adult, but final standing-height/all-view anatomy measurement and human judgement remain incomplete.
clauses.next_action: Independently validate standing dimensions and front/side/rear/three-quarter anatomy.

clauses.name: Character surfaces
clauses.criterion: Clothing reads as cloth through its shape, seams, folds, thickness and restrained material response. Skin, hair, soles, grip tape, deck wood, trucks and wheels have distinct believable responses. Detail must survive the ordinary camera rather than exist only in an asset preview.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Actual fitted ordinaryMain front/side/chase and inspector originals now reviewed. Clothing/face continuity improves; bright nape/hand highlights, stiff collar, soft footwear and plain companion props remain. Final materials under moving gameplay light remain incomplete.
clauses.next_action: Inspect final ordinary camera material/form quality.

clauses.name: Deformation
clauses.criterion: Crouch, deepest landing, push extension, grab and both specials show no collapsed crotch, broken elbow/knee, detached wrists or visible clothing/body penetration. Deformation is reviewed in motion and in the frame at the worst bend.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Actual fitted focus93/0 source-reviewed15/0; inspector9poses211/0 and Main6pushstills159/0 retain seam continuity. Native full fitted/core and temporal03 subsets pass source-bound checks. Angular deepest-grab knee,26internal folded-lapel pairs and normal-speed all-action deformation remain open.
clauses.next_action: Review crouch/landing/push/grab/special bends.

clauses.name: Board construction
clauses.criterion: Deck profile, trucks, wheels, grip, feet placement and board scale are coherent. No wheel visibly detaches, rotates around the wrong axle, penetrates the ordinary skating surface or hovers in an unsupported idle pose.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Actual UV04 side/rim/underside native originals independently reviewed146/0 plus16 source-delta/normal checks. Continuous grain improves; unchanged28mm wood profile and documented bolt/mounting proportions remain physically incoherent. Native32part caches/protected positions stay exact; a physical migration is still unadmitted.
clauses.next_action: Resolve researched physical board dimensions with explicit contact/native component migration and moving retests.

clauses.name: Grounding
clauses.criterion: In supported coast and ordinary grounded trick poses, planted shoe soles target at most 20 mm separation from their intended deck plane. Report maximum and 95th-percentile error where instrumented. Deliberate push/flip/bail separation is labelled and judged against the action.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: ActualMain6stills show coherent supporting/pushing feet and retain original native2056/0 push/brake/pop checks. Independent actual indexed sole world heights are recorded, explicitly without treating height as a floor/load certificate. Complete supported-action maximum/p95 remains absent.
clauses.next_action: Measure final shoe/deck errors and label intentional separation.

clauses.name: Readable physical materials
clauses.criterion: Paving, concrete, sandstone, brick, asphalt, slate, painted steel, glass, grass and water have coherent scale and response under the same lighting. Large route-facing surfaces cannot remain featureless flat colours. Normal and roughness detail support the material rather than produce noisy sparkle.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: D002/D004 remain broad material requirements. Private paving115/0 integrity/allocation passes but bright mortar grid needs actual Main readability. Actual-Main river/basin causal controls137/0 isolate fine-band causes without installing a repair or accepting realism. Exact closed512basin independent204/0 removes banding/preserves exterior shadow in static Main under fixed watercastingOFF; quieterConcrete02 allocation55/0 passes separately, actualMain ground art/temporal remains open.
clauses.next_action: Enumerate and finish actual materials in ordinary views.

clauses.name: Texture scale and resolution
clauses.criterion: Document metres per repeat and actual source resolution. Route-facing hero surfaces target about 256–512 source texels per metre at their intended close view, with sensible mipmaps and filtering. Upsampling does not count as added detail. Match adjoining modules within about 10% apparent scale unless construction calls for a difference.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Asset metadata/rebuild passes; full apparent adjacent scale and all-material target coverage not accepted.
clauses.next_action: Measure actual repeats/resolution/adjacent apparent scale.

clauses.name: Stable surface detail
clauses.criterion: No stretched UVs at banks, giant visible pixels on the normal path, shimmering grass, moiré, unintended normal-map inversion, z-fighting, detached decals or obvious discontinuities at pavement joins. Inspect both stationary and moving frames.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: No full final moving UV/shimmer/seam review.
clauses.next_action: Inspect moving banks, pavement joins and grass.

clauses.name: Architecture
clauses.criterion: Windows/doors have plausible scale, recess and thickness; roofs and cornices meet; no floating trims or regular blockout rows dominate an ordinary route. District silhouettes and credible close-up details identify the place without copied map layouts.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: D002 flat bright window panels remain in inspected GL.
clauses.next_action: Inspect/finish architectural depth, joins and district silhouette.

clauses.name: Light and contact
clauses.criterion: One coherent daylight treatment; wheels, rails and building bases read as grounded. Bright stone retains detail and shaded landings remain readable. No artificial bloom, excessive saturation or crushed blacks conceal missing detail.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Actual-Main water controls retain sunlight/receiving shadows; river bands isolate to water casting and fountain to basin casting. This is a bounded cause test, not complete bright/shaded landing grounding.
clauses.next_action: Review final shadows, bright stone detail and landing clarity.

clauses.name: Composition
clauses.criterion: At least one intentional foreground/middle/background composition on each primary line. Visible boundaries frame returns or destinations. Open space has a skating or visual purpose; clutter cannot replace deliberate composition.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: D003 broad east-quay transport; latest bank-return unseen.
clauses.next_action: Review useful next choices from actual primary decision points.

clauses.criterion: The action reel must show idle, coast, push, brake, crouch, ollie, spin, flip, grab, rail entry/travel/exit, manual, revert, both specials, clean landing, bail and recovery. Add left/right carving, uphill/downhill, rollback, bank takeoff, support loss and a wall-adjacent camera turn. Record accepted input, actual state transitions and whether any setup fixture is used.

clauses.criterion: Ordinary state transitions must have no single-frame pose pops, unexplained body rotation or camera cuts. Instrument discontinuities and distinguish the physical event from cosmetic smoothing. A camera may resolve collision promptly, but must not oscillate or cut through scenery.

clauses.criterion: The board and shoes agree in grounded poses; push-foot ground contact follows the support height. Grabs meet the deck within 50 mm at full extension. These are measurable targets; no “smooth” status is awarded from source inspection.

clauses.criterion: Wheel/ground response, skater lean and landing compression must support the movement. Do not disguise physics defects by sliding an independent visible model over them.

clauses.criterion: The owner-requested push stroke faces and follows actual travel: shoulders/hips open naturally, the supporting foot stays on the deck, the pushing leg extends behind travel and visibly lifts into recovery. Forward/reverse and carving strokes must avoid a side-sweeping leg, lateral foot skid or abrupt torso snap. Review the cycle in normal-speed chase/front/side views, not just a contact marker or static pose.

Measured brisk joint recovery has no invented acceptance threshold. clauses.criterion: Restart, pause, slow speed, reverse travel and repeat inputs must not leave stale trick poses or timers. Reduced motion preserves legibility while removing nonessential camera motion.

clauses.name: Manual linking
clauses.criterion: After the fidelity candidate, explicitly review manual continuity using real air→manual→air and air→manual→ground-bank inputs. Document admitted early/late requests, held/gesture semantics, release and cancellation; observe actual support/link/landing/bank events. No per-tick manual/balance/score/velocity assignment can create the claimed link. Unsupported, expired, low-speed and stale requests must fail deliberately; valid admission must not lose a combo through event-ordering or premature banking.

clauses.name: Balance feedback
clauses.criterion: Balance feedback reads the authoritative state and shows its actual correction axis and direction. Ordinary and nose manuals must actually correct fore/aft with W/S or Up/Down and map nose/tail/stance correctly; relabelling an unchanged lateral control does not meet the owner's request. Grinds use lateral correction/display, and special balance variants follow their modelled support/axis with documented controls. Neutral/risk/bail endpoints and both correction signs must map correctly with current remaps/device prompts. Do not correct balance and unintentionally carve or accelerate with the same control. Keep the moving rider/landing clear, use non-colour risk cues, and clear stale meters at mode exit/restart. UI fixture checks supplement actual-input moving play; they cannot replace it.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Actual board/control signs pass the84 original checks and20 new world-torso assertions in private104/0 epoch; root applied exact visual hunk. Native34/0 HUD correction remains source-bound. Full moving/risk/remap/lateral review remains open.

clauses.name: Original research
clauses.criterion: Research Tony Hawk levels as examples of spatial and mechanical principles. Record inspected sources and distinguish direct observation from design inference. Implement original Glasgow arrangements; do not recreate a franchise map.

clauses.name: Useful density
clauses.criterion: Audit travel time between meaningful trick opportunities, rather than counting decorative props. On authored primary lines at an 8 m/s reference speed, target an opportunity at least every 3 seconds and avoid an unpurposed flat stretch longer than 24 m. Measure actual natural-input traversal separately from the reference calculation.

clauses.name: Connected set pieces
clauses.criterion: Preserve the existing density requirement: each retained core arena has at least two genuinely distinct original returnable lines and a safe bypass. Each line connects a launch, a rail/ledge/manual choice, a landing and a turnaround/re-entry. Reversing the same perimeter is not a second line. Across the six-area world, at least three independently demonstrated circuits must also connect arenas with useful next choices. A prop that cannot be approached and exited at useful speed is not a completed set piece.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: Historical six-geographic-arena benchmark remains unproved. Owner later supersedes retaining that geography in the new default: compact112×88MerchantYard was itself rejected as too small, and a medium dense San-Francisco-inspired original urban plan is being prepared. No replacement layout or circuit is admitted. Preserve CityTour/history and define exact new returned-line/single-combo criteria.
clauses.next_action: Review medium dense urban proposal, freeze its original feature/event graph, then prove actual returned lines and closed single-combo cross-area circuits.

clauses.name: Enclosure and reversibility
clauses.criterion: Architectural edges, banks, courts and end pieces should return the rider toward another opportunity rather than leave them facing an empty boundary. Primary decision points target spacing within roughly 35 m, subject to the specific line's speed and view.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: D003 empty/re-entry baseline deficiency; latest bank-return unreviewed.

clauses.name: Landing and approach
clauses.criterion: Mark approach, takeoff, trick, landing and runout volumes. Ordinary intended landings target at least 3 m clear width. Preserve wider clearance where speed/camera/alternate approaches require it. Scenery and collision match; no invisible obstacle occupies the line.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: All final approach/landing/runout clearances not measured.
clauses.next_action: Mark volumes and test3m+ actual landing widths/misses.

clauses.name: Discoverability
clauses.criterion: From each primary decision point, a useful next feature or destination is visible or deliberately revealed by a short turn. At least one easier bypass accompanies a technical route. Interesting geometry, material wear and lighting guide the line without compulsory floating arrows.
clauses.evidence_or_limit: D003 weak east-quay next choice in baseline/earlier GL.

clauses.criterion: Inspect route centres, both shoulders and deliberate misses. No visible dry ground hole, arbitrary invisible catch slab or abrupt false wall may substitute for authored support and understandable boundaries. River hazards retain deliberate recovery.

clauses.criterion: All ten goals, three core encounters, existing enabled station/train, pond/ducks/cable, park/civic/green content, stable gap/rail IDs, saved progression and district connections remain usable. Preserve personal Music isolation and other implemented content. Further development of traffic/skitch, Cone on a Cruise and the extra park-lap challenge remains deferred under the existing queue. New line density cannot obstruct physical approaches or hide required interaction prompts.

Art upgrades have their own explicit resource budget and matched cost admission. Never optimise a density proxy by scattering decorative curbs, cutting useful recovery flat or weakening native support.

Structural route metadata alone does not prove a playable line. Human discoverability and replay appeal remain explicitly reviewed outcomes.
